title: Netflix Announces a Fictional Miniseries Inspired by the Daniel Sancho Case
summary: Netflix today announced that filming will soon begin on a new fictional miniseries inspired by the case of Daniel Sancho, starring Martiño Rivas
body_markdown:
Entertainment


09 October 2026


Global


Spain


Link copied to clipboard


[Download the images](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/bb9f696f-046c-4a28-ba85-745813f5402d)


Netflix today announced that filming will soon begin on a new fictional miniseries inspired by the case of Daniel Sancho, starring


Martiño Rivas


(


The Final Problem


,


Cable Girls


). The series will be filmed at various locations across Thailand and Spain.


Produced by


Bambú Producciones


(


The Asunta Case


,


Murder in Galicia


), the as-yet-untitled miniseries is executive produced by


Ramón Campos


. It is a fictionalised retelling of the case that captured the country 's attention in the summer of 2023.


About Bambú Producciones


Bambú Producciones is a production company led by screenwriter and producer Ramón Campos. Since its founding in 2008, Bambú has established itself as a leading European production company in international markets, thanks to titles such as


Grand Hotel


,


Velvet


,


Fariña


,


Cable Girls


and


The Asunta Case


. In addition to television series, Bambú also produces documentaries, including


The Alcàsser Murder


,


The Asunta Case


and


Hunting a Monster


, as well as feature films such as


32 Malasaña Street


,


A Widow's Game


,


Band Together


and


Collision Course


.
